subject: Night P1/P2 coverage and fallback matrix — FastLedger
messages:
From: Alex Morris <alex.morris@fastledger.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@fastledger.com
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recurring overnight P1s — need SLA and on-call guarantees

Jonas,

We saw three P1 incidents in the overnight window this week (02:15, 03:40, 04:05 UTC) that impacted job processing for our night batch jobs. Our ops team is stretched and we need clarity on what level of on-call coverage Redwood can guarantee for the midnight–06:00 UTC window.

Specifically: can you confirm P1/P2 response windows for this overnight period, what escalation path you will use if initial on-call does not respond within the target window, and whether you can commit to a temporary routing change while we stabilize our load?

We raised this to our director; they prefer to see a short fallback matrix and an explicit runbook for the next 30 days. Happy to jump on a short call.

Thanks,
Alex Morris
VP Ops, FastLedger
ops@fastledger.com

---

Please note: we are under a multi-tenant SLA and this sequence is hurting our night processing and downstream reporting. Any short-term guarantees will help us decide on the longer-term capacity commitment.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@fastledger.com>, ops@fastledger.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recurring overnight P1s — need SLA and on-call guarantees

Alex — thanks for the clear write-up and the timestamps. Really sorry you hit that sequence. We’ve been tracking a slight pattern on queued batch bursts that can amplify tail latency overnight.

Quick summary of what we can do immediately while we investigate:
- Temporary P1 response SLA: 30 minutes from triage alerting for the midnight–06:00 UTC window (next 30 days).
- P2 response SLA: 2 hours during the same window.
- Escalation ladder: primary on-call (infra/{irene.choi}) -> secondary on-call (platform/sre) -> on-call manager (Grace) -> exec escalation (me). If primary does not acknowledge in 15 minutes we automatically escalate to secondary.
- Routing change: we can pin FastLedger traffic to a reserved pool during the overnight window (soft reservation) and enable prefix caching for frequent batch prompts. This requires a short configuration change but no infra migration.

Irene and Grace — can you review the proposed 30-day temporary SLA and the escalation timing above and confirm we have bandwidth and a runbook? Ben, looping you to coordinate the customer comms and the temporary billing/credits conversation.

I’ll prepare a short fallback matrix and a draft runbook and share in the next message. If you’d like a call, I can be available Monday morning (your timezone).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0169

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@fastledger.com>, ops@fastledger.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2025 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recurring overnight P1s — need SLA and on-call guarantees

Alex — attaching a compact fallback matrix and a runbook draft for the next 30 days so your team can validate. Attachment stubs below.

Attachment stubs: fallback_matrix.csv (small table: condition,action,escalation_target,route), night-runbook-v0.2.md (step-by-step triage, runbook links, KB ids)

Key points from the runbook (summary):
- Monitor: Alert if queue depth > 3x baseline for > 2 minutes (alert -> on-call primary).
- Primary on-call window: 00:00–06:00 UTC; ack target 15 min; response target 30 min for P1.
- Auto-escalation: If ack not received in 15 minutes, page secondary (platform/sre); if still unacknowledged 30 minutes after initial alert, notify Grace as on-call manager.
- Temporary routing: FastLedger traffic will be steered to a reserved pool. If latency > 2s for > 5 minutes, the routing rules will fallback to degraded mode (reduced batching, strict KV cache warm bypass) to prevent cascading failures.
- Credits: we propose a downstream SLA credit if we miss two P1s in a 7-day period during the temporary window. Ben, please confirm the credit template and terms.

We’re not asking for a contract amendment today — this is a 30-day operational carve-in to buy time while engineering finishes a queue mitigation fix. At the end of the 30 days we’ll review telemetry and propose either: 1) a permanent reserved pool add-on, or 2) additional batching/quantization changes to reduce cost.

Alex — can you confirm acceptance of the temporary 30-day SLA and the routing change? If accepted, I’ll route the runbook to the SRE rotation and Grace will sign off.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Morris <alex.morris@fastledger.com>, ops@fastledger.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recurring overnight P1s — need SLA and on-call guarantees

Thanks Jonas — reviewed the matrix and the runbook. I approve the 30-day temporary P1/P2 window with the following operational caveats:

1) Irene: please confirm the primary on-call rotation and ensure secondary pages are configured for automatic escalation (we cannot rely on manual splits).
2) Engineering: add a guard in the ticket template to tag these incidents as FASTLEDGER-NIGHT so we can filter telemetry.
3) Ben: confirm customer comms and the credit language before we send a formal acceptance to Alex.
4) Ops: schedule a 15-minute handoff briefing with FastLedger for tomorrow to walk them through the runbook.

If Irene confirms the rotation automation by EOD tomorrow, we’ll push the routing change and notify FastLedger. I’ll be on call for the first three nights as the manager of record.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Director, Support | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
